estimand: association of one non-target-fold SD higher corrected organ age gap with cause-specific target-organ hazard
population: one row per participant within each organ, restricted to authoritative at_risk == 1
exposure_transform: for outer fold f and organ o, mean/SD and Q1-Q4 cut points are learned from eligible OOF rows in the other four outer folds
primary_model: unpenalized Breslow cause-specific Cox with chronological age per 10 years, binary sex, and continuous gap per crossfit SD; baseline hazard stratified by outer_fold
primary_inference: pooled fold-stratified model-based CI; five fold-specific estimates and inverse-variance fixed-effect meta-analysis with Q/I2 are required robustness evidence
cluster_rationale: within each organ there is exactly one record per participant, so there is no repeated within-organ participant cluster; fold-stratified baseline plus fold-specific meta-analysis address the five model/fold strata
ph_diagnostics: scaled Schoenfeld rank_lifelines_cumsum_event and log-time tests for every covariate; the rank definition preserves (outer_fold, duration) order and applies lifelines 0.30.3 cumsum(event) before selecting event rows; BH family declared in output
time_window_sensitivity: 0-24 month administratively censored Cox and a 24-60 month event-free/alive landmark Cox use the same cross-fitted exposure scale
quartile_role: visualization and sensitivity only; continuous gap remains primary
km: target event with death censored; descriptive rather than competing-risk absolute incidence
competing_risk: deterministic tied-time Aalen-Johansen target CIF with death as competing event
extended_covariates: optional participant-level input; missing-value imputation and continuous scaling must use the other four outer folds
prediction_boundary: all Cox/KM/CIF models in this directory are new downstream association analyses; apparent C-index values must not replace, relabel, or tune the sealed outer-fold EHR-AGE prediction metrics
publication_safety: analysis tables, figure source tables, manifests, and logs are built inside one unique staging bundle and promoted by one directory rename; existing canonical bundles are never overwritten
